name: External Status Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status reason, as published in an external status reason code list.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

AB01.name: Aborted Clearing Timeout
AB01.definition: Clearing process aborted due to timeout.

AB02.name: Aborted Clearing Fatal Error
AB02.definition: Clearing process aborted due to a fatal error.

AB04.name: Aborted Settlement Fatal Error
AB04.definition: Settlement process aborted due to a fatal error.

AB05.name: Timeout Creditor Agent
AB05.definition: Transaction stopped due to timeout at the Creditor Agent.

AB06.name: Timeout Instructed Agent
AB06.definition: Transaction stopped due to timeout at the Instructed Agent.

AB07.name: Offline Agent
AB07.definition: Agent of message is not online.|Generic usage if it cannot be determined who exactly is not online.

AB09.name: Error Creditor Agent
AB09.definition: Transaction stopped due to error at the Creditor Agent.

AB10.name: Error Instructed Agent
AB10.definition: Transaction stopped due to error at the Instructed Agent.

AB11.name: Timeout Debtor Agent
AB11.definition: Transaction stopped due to timeout at the Debtor Agent.

AC01.name: Incorrect Account Number
AC01.definition: Account number is invalid or missing.

AC02.name: Invalid Debtor Account Number
AC02.definition: Debtor account number invalid or missing

AC03.name: Invalid Creditor Account Number
AC03.definition: Creditor account number invalid or missing

AC04.name: Closed Account Number
AC04.definition: Account number specified has been closed on the bank of account's books.

AC06.name: Blocked Account
AC06.definition: Account specified is blocked, prohibiting posting of transactions against it.

AC08.name: Invalid Branch Code
AC08.definition: Branch code is invalid or missing

AC09.name: Invalid Account Currency
AC09.definition: Account currency is invalid or missing

AC10.name: Invalid Debtor Account Currency
AC10.definition: Debtor account currency is invalid or missing

AC11.name: Invalid Creditor Account Currency
AC11.definition: Creditor account currency is invalid or missing

AC12.name: Invalid Account Type
AC12.definition: Account type missing or invalid.|Generic usage if cannot specify between group and payment information levels

AC13.name: Invalid Debtor Account Type
AC13.definition: Debtor account type missing or invalid

AC14.name: Invalid Creditor Account Type
AC14.definition: Creditor account type missing or invalid

AC15.name: Account Details Changed
AC15.definition: The account details for the counterparty have changed.

AC16.name: Card Number Invalid
AC16.definition: Credit or debit card number is invalid.

AG01.name: Transaction Forbidden
AG01.definition: Transaction forbidden on this type of account (formerly NoAgreement)

AG02.name: Invalid Bank Operation Code
AG02.definition: Bank Operation code specified in the message is not valid for receiver

AG03.name: Transaction Not Supported
AG03.definition: Transaction type not supported/authorized on this account.

AG04.name: Invalid Agent Country
AG04.definition: Agent country code is missing or invalid.|Generic usage if cannot specify between group and payment information levels.

AG05.name: Invalid Debtor Agent Country
AG05.definition: Debtor agent country code is missing or invalid

AG06.name: Invalid Creditor Agent Country
AG06.definition: Creditor agent country code is missing or invalid

AG07.name: Unsuccesful Direct Debit
AG07.definition: Debtor account cannot be debited for a generic reason.|Code value may be used in general purposes and as a replacement for AM04 if debtor bank does not reveal its customer's insufficient funds for privacy reasons

AG08.name: Invalid Access Rights
AG08.definition: Transaction failed due to invalid or missing user or access right

AG10.name: Agent Suspended
AG10.definition: Agent of message is suspended from the Real Time Payment system.|Generic usage if it cannot be determined who exactly is suspended.

AG11.name: Creditor Agent Suspended
AG11.definition: Creditor Agent of message is suspended from the Real Time Payment system.

AG12.name: Not Allowed Book Transfer
AG12.definition: Payment orders made by transferring funds from one account to another at the same financial institution (bank or payment institution) are not allowed.

AG13.name: Forbidden Return Payment
AG13.definition: Returned payments derived from previously returned transactions are not allowed.

AGNT.name: Incorrect Agent
AGNT.definition: Agent in the payment workflow is incorrect

AM01.name: Zero Amount
AM01.definition: Specified message amount is equal to zero

AM02.name: Not Allowed Amount
AM02.definition: Specific transaction/message amount is greater than allowed maximum

AM03.name: Not Allowed Currency
AM03.definition: Specified message amount is an non processable currency outside of existing agreement

AM04.name: Insufficient Funds
AM04.definition: Amount of funds available to cover specified message amount is insufficient.

AM06.name: Too Low Amount
AM06.definition: Specified transaction amount is less than agreed minimum.

AM07.name: Blocked Amount
AM07.definition: Amount specified in message has been blocked by regulatory authorities.

AM09.name: Wrong Amount
AM09.definition: Amount received is not the amount agreed or expected

AM10.name: Invalid Control Sum
AM10.definition: Sum of instructed amounts does not equal the control sum.

AM11.name: Invalid Transaction Currency
AM11.definition: Transaction currency is invalid or missing

AM13.name: Amount Exceeds Clearing System Limit
AM13.definition: Transaction amount exceeds limits set by clearing system

AM14.name: Amount Exceeds Agreed Limit
AM14.definition: Transaction amount exceeds limits agreed between bank and client

AM15.name: Amount Below Clearing System Minimum
AM15.definition: Transaction amount below minimum set by clearing system

AM16.name: Invalid Group Control Sum
AM16.definition: Control Sum at the Group level is invalid

AM17.name: Invalid Payment Info Control Sum
AM17.definition: Control Sum at the Payment Information level is invalid

AM18.name: Invalid Number Of Transactions
AM18.definition: Number of transactions is invalid or missing.|Generic usage if cannot specify between group and payment information levels.

AM19.name: Invalid Group Number Of Transactions
AM19.definition: Number of transactions at the Group level is invalid or missing

AM20.name: Invalid Payment Info Number Of Transactions
AM20.definition: Number of transactions at the Payment Information level is invalid

AM21.name: Limit Exceeded
AM21.definition: Transaction amount exceeds limits agreed between bank and client.

AM22.name: Zero Amount Not Applied
AM22.definition: Unable to apply zero amount to designated account. For example, where the rules of a service allow the use of zero amount payments, however the back-office system is unable to apply the funds to the account. If the rules of a service prohibit the use of zero amount payments, then code AM01 is used to report the error condition.

BE01.name: Inconsistent With End Customer
BE01.definition: Identification of end customer is not consistent with associated account number. (formerly CreditorConsistency).

BE04.name: Missing Creditor Address
BE04.definition: Specification of creditor's address, which is required for payment, is missing/not correct (formerly IncorrectCreditorAddress).

BE05.name: Unrecognised Initiating Party
BE05.definition: Party who initiated the message is not recognised by the end customer

BE06.name: Unknown End Customer
BE06.definition: End customer specified is not known at associated Sort/National Bank Code or does no longer exist in the books

BE07.name: Missing Debtor Address
BE07.definition: Specification of debtor's address, which is required for payment, is missing/not correct.

BE09.name: Invalid Country
BE09.definition: Country code is missing or Invalid.|Generic usage if cannot specifically identify debtor or creditor

BE10.name: Invalid Debtor Country
BE10.definition: Debtor country code is missing or invalid

BE11.name: Invalid Creditor Country
BE11.definition: Creditor country code is missing or invalid

BE12.name: Invalid Country Of Residence
BE12.definition: Country code of residence is missing or Invalid.|Generic usage if cannot specifically identify debtor or creditor

BE13.name: Invalid Debtor Country Of Residence
BE13.definition: Country code of debtor's residence is missing or Invalid

BE14.name: Invalid Creditor Country Of Residence
BE14.definition: Country code of creditor's residence is missing or Invalid

BE15.name: Invalid Identification Code
BE15.definition: Identification code missing or invalid.|Generic usage if cannot specifically identify debtor or creditor.

BE16.name: Invalid Debtor Identification Code
BE16.definition: Debtor or Ultimate Debtor identification code missing or invalid

BE17.name: Invalid Creditor Identification Code
BE17.definition: Creditor or Ultimate Creditor identification code missing or invalid

BE19.name: Invalid Charge Bearer Code
BE19.definition: Charge bearer code for transaction type is invalid

BE20.name: Invalid Name Length
BE20.definition: Name length exceeds local rules for payment type.

BE21.name: Missing Name
BE21.definition: Name missing or invalid.  Generic usage if cannot specifically identify debtor or creditor.

BE23.name: Account Proxy Invalid
BE23.definition: Phone number or email address, or any other proxy, used as the account proxy is unknown or invalid.

CERI.name: Check ERI
CERI.definition: Credit transfer is not tagged as an Extended Remittance Information (ERI) transaction but contains ERI.

CH03.name: Requested Execution Date Or Requested Collection Date Too Far In Future
CH03.definition: Value in Requested Execution Date or Requested Collection Date is too far in the future

CH04.name: Requested Execution Date Or Requested Collection Date Too Far In Past
CH04.definition: Value in Requested Execution Date or Requested Collection Date is too far in the past

CH07.name: Element Is Not To Be Used At B-and C-Level
CH07.definition: Element is not to be used at B- and C-Level

CH10.name: Information On Mandate Changes Missing
CH10.definition: Information on mandate changes are missing

CH11.name: Creditor Identifier Incorrect
CH11.definition: Value in Creditor Identifier is incorrect

CH12.name: Creditor Identifier Not Unambiguously At Transaction-Level
CH12.definition: Creditor Identifier is ambiguous at Transaction Level

CH13.name: Original Debtor Account Is Not To Be Used
CH13.definition: Original Debtor Account is not to be used

CH14.name: Original Debtor Agent Is Not To Be Used
CH14.definition: Original Debtor Agent  is not to be used

CH15.name: Element Content Includes More Than 140 Characters
CH15.definition: Content Remittance Information/Structured includes more than 140 characters

CH19.name: Values Will Be Set To Next TARGE Tday
CH19.definition: Values in Interbank Settlement Date or Requested Collection Date will be set to the next TARGET day

CH20.name: Decimal Points Not Compatible With Currency
CH20.definition: Number of decimal points not compatible with the currency

CH22.name: COR Eand B 2 Bwithin Onemessage
CH22.definition: SDD CORE and B2B not permitted within one message.

CHQC.name: Cheque Settled On Creditor Account
CHQC.definition: Cheque has been presented in cheque clearing and settled on the creditor’s account.

CNOR.name: Creditor Bank Is Not Registered
CNOR.definition: Creditor bank is not registered under this BIC in the CSM

CURR.name: Incorrect Currency
CURR.definition: Currency of the payment is incorrect

DNOR.name: Debtor Bank Is Not Registered
DNOR.definition: Debtor bank is not registered under this BIC in the CSM

DS02.name: Order Cancelled
DS02.definition: An authorized user has cancelled the order

DS03.name: Order Not Cancelled
DS03.definition: The user’s attempt to cancel the order was not successful.

DS04.name: Order Rejected
DS04.definition: The order was rejected by the bank side (for reasons concerning content)

DS05.name: Order Forwarded For Postprocessing
DS05.definition: The order was correct and could be forwarded for postprocessing

DS06.name: Transfer Order
DS06.definition: The order was transferred to VEU

DS07.name: Processing OK
DS07.definition: All actions concerning the order could be done by the EBICS bank server

DS08.name: Decompression Error
DS08.definition: The decompression of the file was not successful

DS09.name: Decryption Error
DS09.definition: The decryption of the file was not successful

DS0B.name: Unknown Data Sign Format
DS0B.definition: Data signature for the format is not available or invalid.

DS0D.name: Signer Certificate Not Valid
DS0D.definition: The signer certificate is not valid (revoked or not active).

DS0E.name: Incorrect Signer Certificate
DS0E.definition: The signer certificate is not present.

DS0F.name: Signer Certification Authority Signer Not Valid
DS0F.definition: The authority of the signer certification sending the certificate is unknown.

DS0G.name: Not Allowed Payment
DS0G.definition: Signer is not allowed to sign this operation type.

DS0H.name: Not Allowed Account
DS0H.definition: Signer is not allowed to sign for this account.

DS0K.name: Not Allowed Number Of Transaction
DS0K.definition: The number of transaction is over the number allowed for this signer.

DS10.name: Signer 1 Certificate Revoked
DS10.definition: The certificate is revoked for the first signer.

DS11.name: Signer 1 Certificate Not Valid
DS11.definition: The certificate is not valid (revoked or not active) for the first signer.

DS12.name: Incorrect Signer 1 Certificate
DS12.definition: The certificate is not present for the first signer.

DS13.name: Signer Certification Authority Signer 1 Not Valid
DS13.definition: The authority of signer certification sending the certificate is unknown for the first signer.

DS14.name: User Does Not Exist
DS14.definition: The user is unknown on the server

DS15.name: Identical Signature Found
DS15.definition: The same signature has already been sent to the bank

DS16.name: Public Key Version Incorrect
DS16.definition: The public key version is not correct. This code is returned when a customer sends signature files to the financial institution after conversion from an older program version (old ES format) to a new program version (new ES format) without having carried out re-initialisation with regard to a public key change.

DS17.name: Different Order Data In Signatures
DS17.definition: Order data and signatures don’t match

DS18.name: Repeat Order
DS18.definition: File cannot be tested, the complete order has to be repeated. This code is returned in the event of a malfunction during the signature check, e.g. not enough storage space.

DS19.name: Electronic Signature Rights Insufficient
DS19.definition: The user’s rights (concerning his signature) are insufficient to execute the order

DS20.name: Signer 2 Certificate Revoked
DS20.definition: The certificate is revoked for the second signer.

DS21.name: Signer 2 Certificate Not Valid
DS21.definition: The certificate is not valid (revoked or not active) for the second signer.

DS22.name: Incorrect Signer 2 Certificate
DS22.definition: The certificate is not present for the second signer.

DS23.name: Signer Certification Authority Signer 2 Not Valid
DS23.definition: The authority of signer certification sending the certificate is unknown for the second signer.

DS24.name: Waiting Time Expired
DS24.definition: Waiting time expired due to incomplete order

DS25.name: Order File Deleted
DS25.definition: The order file was deleted by the bank server |(for multiple reasons)

DS26.name: User Signed Multiple Times
DS26.definition: The same user has signed multiple times

DS27.name: User Not Yet Activated
DS27.definition: The user is not yet activated (technically)

DT01.name: Invalid Date
DT01.definition: Invalid date (eg, wrong or missing settlement date)

DT02.name: Invalid Creation Date
DT02.definition: Invalid creation date and time in Group Header (eg, historic date)

DT03.name: Invalid Non Processing Date
DT03.definition: Invalid non bank processing date (eg, weekend or local public holiday)

DT05.name: Invalid Cut Off Date
DT05.definition: Associated message, payment information block or transaction was received after agreed processing cut-off date, i.e., date in the past.

DT06.name: Execution Date Changed
DT06.definition: Execution Date has been modified in order for transaction to be processed

DU02.name: Duplicate Payment Information ID
DU02.definition: Payment Information Block is not unique.

DU04.name: Duplicate End To End ID
DU04.definition: End To End ID is not unique.

DUPL.name: Duplicate Payment Or Charge
DUPL.definition: Payment or charge is a duplicate of another payment or charge.

ED03.name: Balance Info Request
ED03.definition: Balance of payments complementary info is requested

ED05.name: Settlement Failed
ED05.definition: Settlement of the transaction has failed.

ERIN.name: ERI Option Not Supported
ERIN.definition: Extended Remittance Information (ERI) option is not supported.

FF02.name: Syntax Error
FF02.definition: Syntax error reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.

FF03.name: Invalid Payment Type Information
FF03.definition: Payment Type Information is missing or invalid.|Generic usage if cannot specify Service Level or Local Instrument code

FF04.name: Invalid Service Level Code
FF04.definition: Service Level code is missing or invalid

FF05.name: Invalid Local Instrument Code
FF05.definition: Local Instrument code is missing or invalid

FF06.name: Invalid Category Purpose Code
FF06.definition: Category Purpose code is missing or invalid

FF08.name: Invalid End To End Id
FF08.definition: End to End Id missing or invalid

FF10.name: Bank System Processing Error
FF10.definition: File or transaction cannot be processed due to technical issues at the bank side

FF11.name: Clearing Request Aborted
FF11.definition: Clearing request rejected due it being subject to an abort operation.

G000.name: Payment Transferred And Tracked
G000.definition: In an FI To FI Customer Credit Transfer: The Status Originator transferred the payment to the next Agent or to a Market Infrastructure. The payment transfer is tracked. No further updates will follow from the Status Originator.||In a Financial Institution Credit Transfer with cover: The Status Originator performed the account booking and transferred the cover transaction to the next Reimbursement Agent or to a Market Infrastructure. The payment transfer is tracked. No further updates will follow from the Status Originator.

G001.name: Payment Transferred And Not Tracked
G001.definition: In an FI To FI Customer Credit Transfer: The Status Originator transferred the payment to the next Agent or to a Market Infrastructure. The payment transfer is not tracked. No further updates will follow from the Status Originator.||In a Financial Institution Credit Transfer with cover: The Status Originator performed the account booking and transferred the cover transaction to the next Reimbursement Agent or to a Market Infrastructure. The payment transfer is not tracked. No further updates will follow from the Status Originator.

G002.name: Credit Debit Not Confirmed
G002.definition: In a FIToFI Customer Credit Transfer: Credit to the creditor’s account may not be confirmed same day. Update will follow from the Status Originator.|In a Financial Institution Credit Transfer with cover: Debit/credit to nostro account may not be confirmed same day or Financial Institution Credit Transfer may not be transferred same day. Update will follow from the Status Originator.

G003.name: Credit Pending Documents
G003.definition: In a FIToFI Customer Credit Transfer: Credit to creditor’s account is pending receipt of required documents. The Status Originator has requested creditor to provide additional documentation. Update will follow from the Status Originator. |In a Financial Institution Credit Transfer with cover: Status Originator has requested a previous Agent to provide additional information/correct information. Update will follow from the Status Originator.

G004.name: Credit Pending Funds
G004.definition: In a FIToFI Customer Credit Transfer: Credit to the creditor’s account is pending, status Originator is waiting for funds provided via a cover. Update will follow from the Status Originator.

G005.name: Delivered With Service Level
G005.definition: Payment has been delivered to creditor agent with service level.

G006.name: Delivered W Ithout Service Level
G006.definition: Payment has been delivered to creditor agent without service level.

ID01.name: Corresponding Original File Still Not Sent
ID01.definition: Signature file was sent to the bank but the corresponding original file has not been sent yet.

MD02.name: Missing Mandatory Information In Mandate
MD02.definition: Mandate related information data required by the scheme is missing.

MD05.name: Collection Not Due
MD05.definition: Creditor or creditor's agent should not have collected the direct debit

MD06.name: Refund Request By End Customer
MD06.definition: Return of funds requested by end customer

MS02.name: Not Specified Reason Customer Generated
MS02.definition: Reason has not been specified by end customer

MS03.name: Not Specified Reason Agent Generated
MS03.definition: Reason has not been specified by agent.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: Reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.

NERI.name: No ERI
NERI.definition: Credit transfer is tagged as an Extended Remittance Information (ERI) transaction but does not contain ERI.

RC01.name: Bank Identifier Incorrect
RC01.definition: Bank identifier code specified in the message has an incorrect format (formerly IncorrectFormatForRoutingCode).

RC02.name: Invalid Bank Identifier
RC02.definition: Bank identifier is invalid or missing.|Generic usage if cannot specify between debit or credit account

RC03.name: Invalid Debtor Bank Identifier
RC03.definition: Debtor bank identifier is invalid or missing

RC04.name: Invalid Creditor Bank Identifier
RC04.definition: Creditor bank identifier is invalid or missing

RC05.name: Invalid BIC Identifier
RC05.definition: BIC identifier is invalid or missing.|Generic usage if cannot specify between debit or credit account.

RC06.name: Invalid Debtor BIC Identifier
RC06.definition: Debtor BIC identifier is invalid or missing

RC07.name: Invalid Creditor BIC Identifier
RC07.definition: Creditor BIC identifier is invalid or missing

RC08.name: Invalid Clearing System Member Identifier
RC08.definition: ClearingSystemMemberidentifier is invalid or missing.|Generic usage if cannot specify between debit or credit account

RC09.name: Invalid Debtor Clearing System Member Identifier
RC09.definition: Debtor ClearingSystemMember identifier is invalid or missing

RC10.name: Invalid Creditor Clearing System Member Identifier
RC10.definition: Creditor ClearingSystemMember identifier is invalid or missing

RC11.name: Invalid Intermediary Agent
RC11.definition: Intermediary Agent is invalid or missing

RC12.name: Missing Creditor Scheme Id
RC12.definition: Creditor Scheme Id is invalid or  missing

RECI.name: Receiver Customer Information
RECI.definition: Further information regarding the intended recipient.

RF01.name: Not Unique Transaction Reference
RF01.definition: Transaction reference is not unique within the message.

RR01.name: Missing Debtor Account Or Identification
RR01.definition: Specification of the debtor’s account or unique identification needed for reasons of regulatory requirements is insufficient or missing

RR02.name: Missing Debtor Name Or Address
RR02.definition: Specification of the debtor’s name and/or address needed for regulatory requirements is insufficient or missing.

RR03.name: Missing Creditor Name Or Address
RR03.definition: Specification of the creditor’s name and/or address needed for regulatory requirements is insufficient or missing.

RR05.name: Regulatory Information Invalid
RR05.definition: Regulatory or Central Bank Reporting information missing, incomplete or invalid.

RR06.name: Tax Information Invalid
RR06.definition: Tax information missing, incomplete or invalid.

RR07.name: Remittance Information Invalid
RR07.definition: Remittance information structure does not comply with rules for payment type.

RR08.name: Remittance Information Truncated
RR08.definition: Remittance information truncated to comply with rules for payment type.

RR09.name: Invalid Structured Creditor Reference
RR09.definition: Structured creditor reference invalid or missing.

RR10.name: Invalid Character Set
RR10.definition: Character set supplied not valid for the country and payment type.

RR11.name: Invalid Debtor Agent Service ID
RR11.definition: Invalid or missing identification of a bank proprietary service.

RR12.name: Invalid Party ID
RR12.definition: Invalid or missing identification required within a particular country or payment type.

S000.name: Valid Request For Cancellation Acknowledged
S000.definition: Request for Cancellation is acknowledged following validation.

S001.name: UETR Flagged For Cancellation
S001.definition: Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference (UETR) relating to a payment has been identified as being associated with a Request for Cancellation.

S002.name: Network Stop Of UETR
S002.definition: Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference (UETR) relating to a payment has been prevent from traveling across a messaging network.

S003.name: Request For Cancellation Forwarded
S003.definition: Request for Cancellation has been forwarded to the payment processing/last payment processing agent.

S004.name: Request For Cancellation Delivery Acknowledgement
S004.definition: Request for Cancellation has been acknowledged as delivered to payment processing/last payment processing agent.

SL01.name: Specific Service Offered By Debtor Agent
SL01.definition: Due to specific service offered by the Debtor Agent.

SL02.name: Specific Service Offered By Creditor Agent
SL02.definition: Due to specific service offered by the Creditor Agent.

SL03.name: Serviceof Clearing System
SL03.definition: Due to a specific service offered by the clearing system.

SL11.name: Creditor Not On Whitelist Of Debtor
SL11.definition: Whitelisting service offered by the Debtor Agent; Debtor has not included the Creditor on its “Whitelist” (yet). In the Whitelist the Debtor may list all allowed Creditors to debit Debtor bank account.

SL12.name: Creditor On Blacklist Of Debtor
SL12.definition: Blacklisting service offered by the Debtor Agent; Debtor included the Creditor on his “Blacklist”. In the Blacklist the Debtor may list all Creditors not allowed to debit Debtor bank account.

SL13.name: Maximum Number Of Direct Debit Transactions Exceeded
SL13.definition: Due to Maximum allowed Direct Debit Transactions per period service offered by the Debtor Agent.

SL14.name: Maximum Direct Debit Transaction Amount Exceeded
SL14.definition: Due to Maximum allowed Direct Debit Transaction amount service offered by the Debtor Agent.

TA01.name: Transmisson Aborted
TA01.definition: The transmission of the file was not successful – it had to be aborted (for technical reasons)

TD01.name: No Data Available
TD01.definition: There is no data available (for download)

TD02.name: File Non Readable
TD02.definition: The file cannot be read (e.g. unknown format)

TD03.name: Incorrect File Structure
TD03.definition: The file format is incomplete or invalid

TK02.name: Sender Token Not Found
TK02.definition: Token used for the sender does not exist.

TK03.name: Receiver Token Not Found
TK03.definition: Token used for the receiver does not exist.

TK09.name: Token Missing
TK09.definition: Token required for request is missing.

TKVE.name: Token Value Limit Exceeded
TKVE.definition: Token found with value limit rule violation.

TM01.name: Invalid Cut Off Time
TM01.definition: Associated message, payment information block, or transaction was received after agreed processing cut-off time.

TS01.name: Transmission Successful
TS01.definition: The (technical) transmission of the file was successful.

TS04.name: Transfer To Sign By Hand
TS04.definition: The order was transferred to pass by accompanying note signed by hand

FR01.name: Fraud
FR01.definition: Returned as a result of fraud.

NOCM.name: Not Compliant Generic
NOCM.definition: Customer account is not compliant with regulatory requirements, for example FICA (in South Africa) or any other regulatory requirements which render an account inactive for certain processing.

RUTA.name: Return Upon Unable To Apply
RUTA.definition: Return following investigation request and no remediation possible.

AEXR.name: Already Expired RTP
AEXR.definition: Request-to-pay Expiry Date and Time has already passed.

ALAC.name: Already Accepted RTP
ALAC.definition: Request-to-pay has already been accepted by the Debtor.

ARFR.name: Already Refused RTP
ARFR.definition: Request-to-pay has already been refused by the Debtor.

ATNS.name: Attachements Not Supported
ATNS.definition: Attachments to the request-to-pay are not supported.

EDTL.name: Expiry Date Too Long
EDTL.definition: Expiry date time of the request-to-pay is too far in the future.

EDTR.name: Expiry Date Time Reached
EDTR.definition: Expiry date time of the request-to-pay is already reached.

FRAD.name: Fraudulent Origin
FRAD.definition: Cancellation requested following a transaction that was originated fraudulently. The use of the FraudulentOrigin code should be governed by jurisdictions.

IEDT.name: Incorrect Expiry Date Time
IEDT.definition: Expiry date time of the request-to-pay is incorrect.

IRNR.name: Initial RTP Never Received
IRNR.definition: No initial request-to-pay has been received.

NOAR.name: Non Agreed RTP
NOAR.definition: No existing agreement for receiving request-to-pay messages.

NOPG.name: No Payment Guarantee
NOPG.definition: Requested payment guarantee (by Creditor) related to a request-to-pay cannot be provided.

NRCH.name: Payer Or Payer RTPSP Not Reachable
NRCH.definition: Recipient side of the request-to-pay (payer or its request-to-pay service provider) is not reachable.

PINS.name: Type Of Payment Instrument Not Supported
PINS.definition: Type of payment requested in the request-to-pay is not supported by the payer.

REPR.name: RTP Received Can Be Processed
REPR.definition: Request-to-pay has been received and can be processed further.

RTNS.name: RTP Not Supported For Debtor
RTNS.definition: Debtor does not support request-to-pay transactions.

SPII.name: RTP Service Provider Identifier Incorrect
SPII.definition: Identifier of the request-to-pay service provider is incorrect.

FF12.name: Original Transaction Not Eligible For Requested Return
FF12.definition: Original payment is not eligible to be returned given its current status.

FF13.name: Request For Cancellation Not Found
FF13.definition: No record of request for cancellation found.

DC02.name: Settlement Not Received
DC02.definition: Rejection of a payment due to covering FI settlement not being received.

APAR.name: Already Paid RTP
APAR.definition: Request To Pay has already been paid by the Debtor.

AB12.name: Invalid Concurrent Batch
AB12.definition: Duplicate Concurrent Batch Sequence number– for Settlement Instructions.

AB13.name: Invalid Routing Code Utilised
AB13.definition: Wrong Message Routing Type for Return-of-Funds.

AB15.name: Invalid Account Number For Settlement Type
AB15.definition: Instruction may not be placed on the Continuous Processing Line settlement processor.

BDAY.name: Not Business Day
BDAY.definition: Settlement Cycle Day and Calendar day should be the same.

DS28.name: Return For Technical Reason
DS28.definition: Message routed to the wrong environment.

INDT.name: Invalid Details
INDT.definition: Details not valid for this field.

ISWS.name: Invalid Settlement Window
ISWS.definition: Cannot schedule instruction for Night Window.

MINF.name: Missing Information
MINF.definition: Information missing for the field or cannot be empty.

NOFR.name: Outstanding Funding For Settlement
NOFR.definition: Continuous Processing Line on Hold Instruction.

RC13.name: Participant Not An Active Memberof RTGS

RC15.name: Participant Not Active Member Settlement Type

SBRN.name: Settlement Batch Removal Notification
SBRN.definition: Remove Concurrent Batch Processing Line on hold instruction.

RQNR.name: Request Not Recognized
RQNR.definition: Payer did not recognize the request from Payee Participant,

SNRD.name: Service Not Rendered
SNRD.definition: Services are not yet rendered by the Payee Participant (Creditor).

OSNS.name: Optional Service Not Supported
OSNS.definition: Requested optional service (for example instalment payments) is not supported.

AMSE.name: Attachment Maximum Size
AMSE.definition: Size of the attachment exceeds the allowed maximum.

EDNA.name: Execution Date Not Accepted
EDNA.definition: Requested execution date of the payment is not accepted.

SL15.name: Maximum Number Of Credit Transactions Exceeded
SL15.definition: Maximum number of credit transactions allowed by the account servicer per service period exceeded.

SL16.name: Maximum Credit Transactions Amount Exceeded
SL16.definition: Maximum total credit amount allowed by the account servicer per service period exceeded.

SL17.name: Debtor Not On Whitelist Of Creditor Side
SL17.definition: Whitelisting service offered by payment system operator or financial institution. Debtor is not included on the Creditor side whitelist.

SL18.name: Debtor On Blacklist Of Creditor Side
SL18.definition: Blacklisting service offered by payment system operator or financial institution. Debtor included on the Creditor side blacklist.

CHRG.name: Underlying Charge Bearer Was Not Debt
CHRG.definition: Related to a Charge message to convey that the charge bearer code used in the corresponding Payment message was not debt.

CHCO.name: Unaccepted Charge Code Type
CHCO.definition: Related to a Charge message to convey that the code in Charge Breakdown / Type / Code is not accepted by the receiving party.

IPNS.name: Instalment Payments Not Supported
IPNS.definition: Payments in instalments are not supported.

EOL1.name: End Of Life
EOL1.definition: Expiration of the payment authorisation due to no use for too long.

PNRT.name: Payment Not Aligned With RTP Request
PNRT.definition: Error code used for RTP-initiated CTR when the pacs.008 details are not aligned with the pain.013 request.

OBO1.name: Settlement Completed Reported On Behalf Of Creditor Agent With Amount
OBO1.definition: Settlement of the transaction has been completed and is reported by an intermediary agent or Payment Market Infrastructure on behalf of the Creditor Agent. The credited amount is known.

OBO2.name: Settlement Completed Reported On Behalf Of Creditor Agent Without Amount
OBO2.definition: Settlement of the transaction has been completed and is reported by an intermediary agent or Payment Market Infrastructure on behalf of the Creditor Agent. The credited amount is not known.

G007.name: Payment Passed By Payment Market Infrastructure
G007.definition: The payment has been passed by the Payment Market Infrastructure to the next agent in the payment chain; receipt has not yet been confirmed.

G008.name: Payment Received By Next Agent Via Payment Market Infrastructure
G008.definition: The payment has been received by the next agent via the Payment Market Infrastructure.

AEML.name: Amount Exceeds Max Limit
AEML.definition: Requested amount exceeds the limit set by Debtor (Agent)

WGDA.name: Wrong Debtor Agent
WGDA.definition: Wrong Debtor Agent in charge request message

WGDB.name: Wrong Debtor
WGDB.definition: Wrong Debtor in charge request message

MICT.name: Multiple Identical Charge Types
MICT.definition: Multiple identical Charge Types in Charge Breakdown

GUAG.name: Guaranteed Agreement Breached
GUAG.definition: Guaranteed Agreement with Correspondent, therefore Correspondent is the liable party
